observations_and_questions.classification: bounded source contract; no new unique finding
observations_and_questions.trace: PiercedDomain checks each hole vertex inside the outer boundary with >=3mm minimum web; it checks pairs of holes for containment/vertex-to-edge proximity and proper crossings, samples boundary and interior, maps Spade CDT errors to InvalidSurface, filters tiny area and centroid regions and emits reversed u32 triangle indices. The selected close-helmet new layout validates its design before constructing a BakeSource visor; that visor builds a specific shield outer boundary and derives its holes from typed sight/breath controls. The selected buffe uses a rectangular chart and the same domain.
observations_and_questions.limits: The shared domain does not independently prove finite/simple/nonempty outer loops, whole-segment containment against a nonconvex outer, no coincident edges, or u32 index capacity for arbitrary inputs; checking hole vertices alone is not a universal segment-containment proof. The selected source contexts constrain some values, but we did not prove all polygon, caller, Spade, topology or GPU invariants. Do not claim a reachable native panic or error categorization without those proofs. Original 774 ADDITIONAL-062 and 059 q609 preserve the native/geometry boundaries; 059 q1813/q3141 and the earlier buffe assessment are related without automatic aliases.

observations_and_questions.classification: bounded mathematical guard confirmation, no new finding
observations_and_questions.trace: ArmorDetail::segments divides by nonzero 1/12/16/24, then max(minimum) is capped by source, so source zero yields zero. The pierced boundary sampler explicitly uses steps.max(1), and rounded_slot uses fixed source 4/minimum 1, yielding nonzero corner_steps for every closed detail variant. The visor interior uses segments(20,3), so it is at least 3 and at most 20, making 20/segments a positive step. These are source/math arguments only.
observations_and_questions.limits: A positive sampling divisor does not establish finite, nondegenerate or simple geometry. A zero source with positive minimum is an intentional consequence of capping rather than proof every caller accepts zero. No complete caller inventory, geometry or test execution. Prior rig ADDITIONAL-063 and 059 Segovb L11-427 already establish the same central guards.

The inspected cloth checker uses part.indices.len()/3 and rejects counts >=10,000; the gown finish invokes the checker after optional lining append and join finish. The selected recipe dispatch routes gown through that finish; its Skirt, Bodice and Partlet branches do not invoke this checker at that location. observations_and_questions.limits: Per-model could mean one exported article or a wider assembled model; inspect design policy, other route-specific guards, renderer accounting, native index invariants and supported producer ranges before asserting inconsistent enforcement or an over-budget result. No generated or synthetic mesh was run. Tests seen as source in role2616 were not run, and prior source mentions do not establish measured counts.
observations_and_questions.future_direction: Resolve the intended boundary and inclusive/exclusive threshold at the canonical owner, then trace all supported article assembly and reporting paths. Do not alter the constant or production behavior during audit.
